Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 141. Category: technique. Rank 3.

Rank 3 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 35 ki
Prerequisites: none
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: self (90-foot Sphere)
Chargeable?: No
Duration: 2 Rounds
Type: Omni
The user concentrates Ki in front of their eyes and
sends a blinding light forward in a 90-foot sphere and
anyone in the area must make a con save or be blinded
for the duration, on a success they are blinded for half
as long.
